description: Starts a research task: a question answered by reading public pages, with sources, progress and cost. Free over MCP. No API key or account. The execution budget bounds the task, without charging the client. Returns a task id: check it with web_task_status.

limits.description: Bounds on cost, time and steps.

max_cost_usd.description: Most the task may cost, in USD. Execution budget. Free over MCP; charged as a fixed package over HTTP/x402. No automatic on-chain refund.

max_duration_seconds.description: Longest the task may run, in seconds.

max_steps.description: Most decisions the planner may take.

mode.description: Only research is available: read public pages and answer.

task.description: What to find out, in plain words. Be specific about what to compare.

urls.description: Pages to read first, up to 5. Public http or https urls only.

name: web_task_start
